title: Code defects the docs sweep found: system's checks, new-user's next steps, vscode's dock, claude's mkdir refusal, zsh.bats' HOME, a dead CI step, dead template values (hv, 3 Nov)
body:
## What

The docs sweep (0084) found code defects, listed in 0084's as-built note. hv, 3 Nov 2026, in molt-vc's session: "fix the code issues too, then hold."

1. `system`: its check never looks for Homebrew on macOS, so a Mac without it passes. On Linux, install passes for a user in no sudo group, so the check fails on every run while resleeve prints "installed". The group test knows only `sudo`, so Fedora, RHEL and Arch users, whose group is `wheel`, always fail.
2. `molt new-user`: the next steps it prints fail on a fresh machine. `git commit` needs the identity only a resleeve links; the push names the `github.com-<github>` ssh host, which only a resleeve renders; and `git init` may make `master` where the push names `main`. Its help text and messages say `molt-{user}` for the `Molt-{user}` directory it makes.
3. `vscode`: install ignores a failed `molt_gsettings set` and says the dock was changed; an empty dock, `@as []`, becomes `@as [, 'code.desktop']`. `writing-a-liberator.md`'s dock example has the same empty-list fault.
4. `claude`: a config dir that cannot be made fails without the "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR was not handed over" line every other refusal prints.
5. `test/liberators/zsh.bats` replaces setup without `molt_test_setup`, so its check and verify tests read the real HOME.
6. `.github/workflows/tests.yml` sets a git identity that no test has read since issue 0062, when `test_helper.bash` gave git an empty global config.
7. Templates: the skeleton's `[sleeve]` table and `instance.toml`'s `[instance]` table are read by nothing, the skeleton's `vars.sh` sets `MOLT_PLATFORM="macos"`, which nothing reads, on every platform, and `molt.toml.example` gives `system` only Linux.

## Next

vc, on HEAD: each fix with a test that fails without it, ShellCheck clean, the suite under bash 5 and `/bin/bash` 3.2, booked through the estate desk, then CI on the push. No release unless hv asks.

## As built

vc, 3 Nov 2026, on HEAD, in one commit with this note.

1. `liberators/system.sh`: `_system_faults` names each fault with its remedy: no sudo; on Linux, a user in neither the sudo nor the wheel group, each matched as a whole name in `groups`' output; on macOS, no Homebrew. Check, install and verify all report it through `molt_report_faults`, so install fails wherever check does. The new `test/liberators/system.bats` runs the liberator with PATH holding only fakes.
2. `lib/newuser.sh`: the next steps resleeve before `git init -b main`, the commit and the push, and say why. Its messages and `bin/molt`'s help name the `Molt-<user>` directory. `newuser.bats` checks the order and the branch, and `new-user.md` quotes the new steps.
3. `liberators/vscode.sh`: an empty dock gets `['code.desktop']`, a refused set fails install, and the entry is held in a variable, since bash 3.2 kept the backslashes of `\'` in the old replacement. Three tests in `vscode.bats` run against a fake gsettings that keeps each key in a file. The liberator guide's dock example does the same.
4. `liberators/claude.sh`: the mkdir refusal calls `_claude_unpublished`. A test in `claude.bats` makes `~/.config` read-only.
5. `test/liberators/zsh.bats` runs `molt_test_setup`. The other files that replace setup (install, instances, manifest, templates) each set a HOME of their own, and `test_helper.bash` now says which run it.
6. `.github/workflows/tests.yml`: both git identity steps are gone, and `.claude/restart.md` says CI sets none.
7. Templates: `[sleeve]`, `[instance]` and `MOLT_PLATFORM` are gone from the skeleton, and the example runs `system` on macOS too. README, `MODULES.md`, `new-user.md` and `getting-started.md` follow.

Proof: ShellCheck is clean on every changed script. The full suite passed under bash 5, 642 tests. Under `/bin/bash` 3.2, 641 passed, and the new test of a dock with favourites failed: bash 3.2 kept the backslashes of `\'` in vscode's replacement, written before this issue and never run on a 3.2 shell. With the entry held in a variable, vscode.bats passes under both, 5 tests each. Each run was in a slot pplr-vc granted. The new tests were not run against the old code.

Not done: Molt-matts' instance manifests still carry `[sleeve]` tables, and its `vars.sh` files `MOLT_PLATFORM`, which nothing reads. They are hv's stack config.
